name: Block App Updates
compatibility: Targets iOS 15-26 on rootless and native RootHide. ichitaso tested 1.0.5 on iOS 16.5 Dopamine, iOS 17.5.1 Dopamine and iOS 26.0.1 RootHide. sahinkaa tested 1.0.4 on iOS 16.6 RootHide and iOS 26.0.1 RootHide.
description: Block updates for selected App Store apps while preserving your Home Screen layout and notification choices. iOS 15-26.
author: sahinkaa • ichitaso

changes: Preserve the existing Allow or Don't Allow notification choice of all jailbreak, TrollStore and TrollStore Lite apps after the App Store refresh, not only Sileo's.
Trim stray whitespace from helper messages shown in alerts.
Set the helper's setuid bit and the installer scripts' permissions while packaging, so `make package` alone produces a correct package. Remove `normalize_package.py` and simplify `build.sh`.
Automatically save and restore Home Screen folders and icon placement when applying changes. The restored layout persists across later resprings.
Preserve Sileo's existing notification choice after the App Store refresh so it does not ask again.
Shorten the confirmation and show that the device will respring when the refresh is complete.
Show each application's version next to its name in the Settings list, as in 1.0.0's original design.
Fall back to the bundle name when an application's display name is empty, fixing applications listed without a name.

Re-register jailbreak, TrollStore and TrollStore Lite applications after the LaunchServices rebuild, fixing apps that stopped launching, lost their icon labels, disappeared or ran letterboxed after committing changes.
Finish committing as soon as LaunchServices reflects the changed applications instead of always waiting at least 60 seconds (about 15–30 seconds in total on iOS 15-26).
Restart `appstored` together with App Store so blocked and unblocked applications appear correctly in the update list.
Fit application icons to the Settings list rows.
Initial public release.
Selectively blocks and restores App Store updates per application.
Supports staging multiple changes and applying one LaunchServices refresh.
Separates blocked updates from available applications.
Excludes TrollStore-installed applications.
Detects reinstalled applications and clears obsolete blocked metadata.
Supports rootless iOS 15 and later on arm64 and arm64e devices.
Requests Restart SpringBoard after installation, upgrade and removal.

name: Tinge 26
compatibility: Requires jailbroken iOS 26. Choose the standard rootless or native RootHide build for your jailbreak.
description: Customize Home Screen badges with adaptive colors, text and borders on iOS 26.
author: P2KDev • sahinkaa

changes: Added Darken / Lighten Threshold for adaptive text and borders. It defaults to 60 on a scale from 0 White to 100 Black. Backgrounds at or above the threshold get lighter shades. Backgrounds below it get darker shades. The preview updates as you drag.
Set the first-launch defaults to 60 for the threshold, 66 for text shade difference, 1.5 pt for border width and 30 for border shade difference. Double-tap any slider to reset it to its default.
Renamed Text Color to Text. Static color pickers now appear only when Static is selected.
Added a live preview with four installed app icons. Tap an icon to swap it for another app.
Added separate Adaptive Shade Difference sliders for badge text and borders. Both range from 0 to 100.
Improved adaptive borders so they lighten or darken in the same direction as adaptive text.
Set the border width range to 0–3 points in 0.1-point increments.
Refined slider haptics so each endpoint gives a single tick per drag.
Moved Respring beside the main Enabled switch and tightened the credits layout.
Added a new four-badge icon.
Reuse cached icon colors when a new badge appears.
Preserve the same icon's sampled color through badge count changes.
Retry unavailable icon pixels early with a bounded recovery sequence.
Keep valid background paint visible while the same icon's appearance refreshes.
Reject stale callbacks after view reuse or a folder's highest-count app changes.
Preserve static badge backgrounds, text colors, borders, highest-count folder coloring and safe animated badge updates.

name: ApnHistory Remade
compatibility: Targets iOS 15 through iOS 26. Rootless and RootHide packages are available.
description: Encrypted local history for app notifications, incoming SMS and calls. Search by app or timeline, copy text or view raw details. Filter what gets logged, protect entries and delete them manually or with automatic cleanup rules. Customize the background and blur. Back up and restore settings and history with password-protected files.
author: m156nrkvv • sahinkaa

changes: Lowered the Per App and Timeline tabs and Settings gear to prevent status bar overlap on Dynamic Island devices.
Centered the tab divider on the screen and the Settings gear in the space to its right.
Added a small gap above the separator and expanded the header tap areas.
Encrypted history storage. Existing notifications migrate to an encrypted SQLite database. New notifications are queued securely and imported when you open or refresh ApnHistory.

Logging and cleanup rules. Choose which apps and keywords to log or ignore. Set a maximum age or item count, create automatic cleanup rules and manage Auto Protect in one place. Set a rule’s range to 0 to disable it while keeping it in the list.
Filter and manage saved items. Filter by app, text and date with a live match count. Protect, unprotect or delete selected entries in bulk. Delete Selected skips protected entries.
Password-protected backups in Files. Back up and restore settings, history or both using On My iPhone or iCloud Drive. Restore merges history with existing entries and skips matching notifications.
Timeline navigation. Drag the side scrollbar to move through your history with a month and year readout. Light haptics mark month changes and the top and bottom of the list.
Per App groups. Groups start collapsed and reset when you return from Timeline. Tap an app to expand its history.
Layout and reading. Top controls respect the safe area. Tap a long notification to read the rest or hold it for actions.

Navigation, live search, backup and restore performed well with 80,000 history items on iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.6, Dopamine RootHide) and iPhone 11 Pro Max (iOS 26.0.1, Dopamine RootHide). A decade of history can fit in under 100 MB, depending on notification volume and content.
Added live search to Per App and Timeline.
Tap an app header to expand or collapse its history. Counts show all saved items or only matches while searching.
Added a 0–100% blur strength control for photo backgrounds.
Set Maximum Items Saved to 0 for unlimited history or enter a custom limit, including values above 10,000.
Renamed Settings controls to Log App Notifications, Log SMS, Log Calls, Solid Color and Blur Effect.
